title: Checkout
metaDescription: Sign in to try Stripe Checkout for your AVENOR selection.
intro: Review your selection, then continue to the hosted Stripe test payment.

payment.title: Pay with Stripe · Test mode
payment.description: Enter contact, delivery and payment details directly on Stripe. AVENOR sends only your product selection. Delivery countries: Germany and Austria.

demoNotice: Test payments only: use Stripe test cards and fictional contact details. Stripe processes your input. No goods are shipped.
loadError: Checkout cannot be loaded right now. Your selection is kept.

empty.title: Your bag is empty.
empty.description: Choose a product before trying the checkout.

review.blocked: Some items are unavailable or not available in the selected quantity. Please update your shopping bag.
review.changed: A price or available quantity has changed. Your summary has been updated. Please review it and complete the demo again.
review.network: The final check failed. Your selection and form entries are kept. Please try again.

stripe.notConfigured: Stripe is not configured. Add the test key to your local .env file and start the payment API.
stripe.storage: Session storage is unavailable. Enable it so your payment can be verified when you return.
stripe.changed: A price or stock level changed. Refresh your selection and review it again.
stripe.network: Unable to prepare payment. Check that the local payment API is running and try again. Your bag is kept.
stripe.limit: Test payments are limited to a subtotal of EUR 10,000. Please reduce your selection.

stripeReturn.description: Server-verified status of your Stripe test payment.
stripeReturn.paid: Stripe confirms your successful test payment. Paid quantities have been removed from your bag. Nothing will be shipped.
stripeReturn.checking: The server is checking the payment status with Stripe.
stripeReturn.pending: Stripe has not confirmed a completed payment. Your bag is kept. You can check the status again.
stripeReturn.canceled: You returned without a confirmed payment. Your bag is kept.
stripeReturn.expired: Start a new test payment from your bag. Your selection is kept.
stripeReturn.missing: The local receipt key is missing or the link is invalid. Open the return page in the browser tab where you started payment.
stripeReturn.error: Unable to confirm the status. Your bag is kept. Check again before starting another payment.
stripeReturn.storageWarning: The bag update could not be saved. After reloading, you may need to remove paid items yourself.
